content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Sc. / BE Other conditions: The appointment is purely temporary for 179 days or until the completion of the project. Candidates must attend the walk-in interview at their own expense with original documents.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary appointment for 179 days or until the end of the scheme, whichever is earlier Appointment may be terminated at any time without giving any reason Appointment gives no right to direct appointment in the Agricultural University

content_sections.heading: How Will UAS Dharwad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview Interview at the Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti Appropriate representation will be given to SC/ST candidates in the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application proforma Original documents related to educational qualification Two attested copies of the documents Two photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in your details in the application proforma printed with the notice. Attend the interview on 23-11-2026 at 11.00 AM at the Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti, with the proforma and two attested copies. Do not send the application in advance.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The application must not be sent in advance under any circumstances

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 23 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 16,718 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Sc. / BE.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointment is purely temporary for 179 days or until the completion of the project. Candidates must attend the walk-in interview at their own expense with original documents.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview at the Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti. Appropriate representation will be given to SC/ST candidates in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary appointment for 179 days or until the end of the scheme, whichever is earlier. Appointment may be terminated at any time without giving any reason. Appointment gives no right to direct appointment in the Agricultural University.
